name: Richard Lionheart
style: The all-rounder: a clean three-hit longsword string that launches on the third swing, a golden Sun Crescent to hit from range, and Lion's Roar to clear the space around him.

moves.name: Lion Combo
moves.notes: Three quick swings. The third is slower and launches the opponent into the air.

moves.name: Rising Lion
moves.notes: A rising swing that pops the opponent up to float. Jump after them to keep the combo going.

moves.name: Sky Lion
moves.notes: Three air swings. The first two keep the opponent close and in the air; the third knocks them down.

moves.name: Crusader's Plunge
moves.notes: Drops straight down with the sword. If it connects you bounce back up.

moves.name: Sun Crescent
moves.notes: A big cleave whose arc flies on as a golden crescent for a mid-range hit. Ready again about 3 seconds after each throw.

moves.name: Heavy Cleave
moves.notes: The plain heavy while the Sun Crescent is cooling. Slow to start, but it breaks guards.

moves.name: Crusader's Throw
moves.notes: Grabs a grounded opponent in reach, and a guard does not stop it. The victim can break free by pressing LIGHT or HEAVY in the first moment of the grab.

moves.name: Lion's Roar
moves.notes: A royal war cry: a golden shockwave throws everyone close away. Cooldown about 7 seconds.

moves.name: Radiant Cleave
moves.notes: Rift Art, ready at a full Rift gauge. Gathers sunlight into the blade and hurls a crescent wave across the arena.

moves.name: Lion's Step
moves.notes: A low, guarded burst step. Invulnerable for its first 9 ticks (about 0.15 seconds). On the ground it has a cooldown; in the air it uses one of your air dashes.

combos.name: Launch and juggle
combos.notes: The launcher pops them up to float. Jump after them and finish with the air string.

combos.name: Swing and plunge
combos.notes: The third swing sends them up. Jump after them and drop the plunge onto them.

combos.name: Breaker
combos.notes: Two quick swings, then the throw if they are still in front of you. Use it against a guarding opponent, since a guard does not stop a throw.
